title: Great Nicobar EIA (2021 draft)
source: Draft EIA by Vimta Labs for ANIIDCO, December 2021
checks: Internal contradictions and recycled figures (Nemotron Ultra)

findings.title: Same figure for different places, pages 818, 851

quotes.text: About 648 species of flora have been reported from the area belonging to 422 genera and 142 families
About 648 species of flora have been reported from the area belonging to 422 genera and 142 families

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 13 possible explanation words searched

evidence.label: Other figures shared by these pages

findings.why: The same flora and fauna species counts with identical breakdowns are given for two different national parks (Campbell Bay and Galathea) without any explanation for the duplication.
findings.clear: Separate survey data for each site, or a note that one common source covers all of them.

findings.title: Same figure for different places, pages 818, 851, 1168

quotes.text: a total of 330 species of fauna are recorded from the Campbell Bay National Park
a total of 330 species of fauna are recorded from the Galathea National Park
A total of 330 species of fauna are recorded from the whole GNI area

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 22 possible explanation words searched

evidence.label: Other figures shared by these pages

findings.why: The identical figure of 330 fauna species with the same taxonomic breakdown appears for three different geographic subjects (Campbell Bay National Park, Galathea National Park, and the whole GNI area) without any stated justification.
findings.clear: Separate survey data for each site, or a note that one common source covers all of them.

findings.title: Pages 392 and 978 disagree

quotes.text: As per the ZSI report, no coral exists in the bay portion of the Galathea Bay.
Coral reef exists in the proposed site for Transshipment / Port

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 11 possible explanation words searched

findings.why: Page 392 states the ZSI report found no coral in the bay portion of Galathea Bay, while page 978's preliminary assessment states a coral reef exists in the proposed transshipment/port site, which is located in Galathea Bay. The report does not reconcile these contradictory findings on these pages.
findings.clear: A statement in the report that the two passages cover different areas, dates or scopes, or a correction of one of them.

findings.title: Pages 940 and 1168 disagree

quotes.text: A total of 695 species of fauna with the endemism of 158 species
A total of 330 species of fauna are recorded from the whole GNI area

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 14 possible explanation words searched

findings.why: Page 940 reports 695 fauna species from Great Nicobar Island, while page 1168 records 330 fauna species from the whole GNI area. The report does not explain this discrepancy on these pages.
findings.clear: A statement in the report that the two passages cover different areas, dates or scopes, or a correction of one of them.

findings.title: Pages 851 and 940 disagree

quotes.text: About 648 species of flora have been reported from the area belonging to 422 genera and 142 families
approximately 600 species of flora reported from Great Nicobar Island

evidence.label: Checked by
evidence.value: Nemotron Ultra, reading both full pages; 12 possible explanation words searched

findings.why: Galathea National Park is located within Great Nicobar Island, yet the park's reported flora (648 species) exceeds the island's approximate total (600 species). The report cites different sources and does not clarify the discrepancy.
findings.clear: A statement in the report that the two passages cover different areas, dates or scopes, or a correction of one of them.
